title: Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – June 23, 2026

note:
### Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – June 23, 2026

#### Hotfix Gameplay Update

This is a hotfix containing gameplay updates. Replay codes from the June 16 patch are still available.

#### Neon Junction

* Slightly lowered payload speed.
* Increased payload unlock time after point capture.
* Increased payload wait time at the end of area 2.
note_cn:
### 《守望先锋》正式服更新说明 - 2026年6月23日

#### 游戏玩法在线修正

本次在线修正包含游戏玩法更新。6月16日补丁的录像代码依然可用。

#### 霓虹枢纽

* 略微降低了运载目标的移动速度。
* 增加了占领目标点后运载目标的解锁时间。
* 增加了运载目标在区域2终点的等待时间。
